query: Which evaluation metrics and threshold calibration methods balance detector AUC and low false positives while preserving student safeguards?

response.query: Which evaluation metrics and threshold calibration methods balance detector AUC and low false positives while preserving student safeguards?
response.answer: Precision AUC calibration and the use of false positive thresholds below 1% balance detector performance and safeguard students by minimizing unnecessary alerts while maintaining high detection accuracy.

results.title: Tobacco Product Standard for Nicotine Yield of Cigarettes and ...
results.content: As a result of the proposed product standard, many youth and young adults would not be subjected to the impacts of nicotine addiction from cigarette smoking and certain other combusted tobacco products (which have a significantly stronger effect on youth due, in part, to their developing brains, as described in sections IV.B and IV.C of this document), nor would they suffer from the adverse health effects and mortality that these products cause. FDA expects that this proposed product standard, therefore, would have significant benefits for youth and young adults by reducing the risk that those who experiment with cigarettes and certain other combusted tobacco products would progress to regular use as a result of nicotine dependence. FDA is issuing this proposal because the tobacco products subject to this proposed product standard remain addictive due to the nicotine yield they offer users and because combusted tobacco products are responsible for the majority of tobacco-related death and disease (see section IV.D of this document for a discussion regarding the serious negative health effects of smoking cigarettes and other combusted tobacco products).
